data.body: [P2] Do not discard owner-thread cleanup while operation owners may still be running. Fatal shutdown stops waiting after its bounded allowance, but this empties the list immediately. An interrupt-ignoring peer that later unwinds calls `onUserFunctionEndAfterFatal()` against an empty list, leaving its plugin/OTel scope active on a reusable worker. Associate each started attempt with its plugin snapshot or defer release until those owners settle, and test a peer released after the invocation fails.
